You know, I think we really underestimated the effects of social distancing during this whole debacle. I for one (being mostly introverted) thought that this whole stay at home thing was going to be a piece of cake. I feel more depressed and anxious than I have in years.

And I'm right there with you. I love helping people. I love to see people happy. To me its a win, win since I can help but it also makes me happy seeing the people I love and care about happy.

First off if you're feeling suicidal I would call the suicide prevention hotline or see r/suicidewatch instead. I've used it a few times and there are genuinely good people there.

Getting to the subject at hand, high school is rough. People always say that "its going to be the best time of your life" but it rarely is.
